1. "id": the result of (12 times 3) plus 35 — as a number, not a string
2. "name": the word "rocket" spelled BACKWARDS, all lowercase
3. "tags": exactly these 5 strings sorted in REVERSE alphabetical (Z to A) order: "grove", "humus", "flint", "ember", "delta"

5. "meta": a nested object with exactly two keys — "len": the number of letters in "rocket" (as a number), and "even": a boolean saying whether the value of "id" is an even number
Any extra key, wrong type, wrong order inside "tags", wrong nesting, or wrong casing counts as a mistake.
